topic: Impulse buying: the 24-hour rule, wait one day before buying anything you did not plan.

episode.title: Coin & Kash: The 24-Hour Pause

shots.narration: That cute mug wasn't planned—but Kash wants it now!
shots.scene: Bright modern cafe merchandise corner, one colourful ceramic mug on a plain shelf, vertical 9:16, clean 3D animation, no text or signage.
shots.action: Kash reaches toward the colourful mug.
shots.mood: Wide sparkling eyes, eager smile, warm inviting colours.

shots.narration: Coin suggests a pause before this unplanned purchase.
shots.scene: The same cafe shelf, colourful mug within Kash's reach, vertical 9:16, no text or signage.
shots.action: Coin raises one tiny palm between Kash and the mug.
shots.mood: Gentle interruption, friendly smile, Kash's eyebrows lifted.

shots.narration: [surprised] The 24-hour rule? Wait one day before buying anything unplanned.
shots.scene: Cafe corner with a floating picture-only sequence of sun, moon, and sun, vertical 9:16, no writing or numbers.
shots.action: Coin points along the sun–moon–sun sequence.
shots.mood: Clear bright symbols, cheerful teaching moment, attentive Kash.

shots.narration: Kash leaves the mug right where it is.
shots.scene: Cafe merchandise shelf with the untouched colourful mug, vertical 9:16, no text or signage.
shots.action: Kash withdraws her hand from the mug.
shots.mood: Relaxed shoulders, small determined smile, calm warm lighting.

shots.narration: At home, her pause continues into the evening.
shots.scene: Clean modern city flat, orange evening sky outside a tall window, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.mood: Quiet cosy room, soft orange light, peaceful expression.

shots.narration: [chuckles] One day later, there's no rush toward that mug.
shots.scene: The same city flat the following evening, orange sky beyond closed curtains, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.mood: Matching evening light, rested expression, easy unhurried posture.

shots.narration: Back at the cafe, Kash decides to leave it.
shots.scene: The familiar cafe merchandise corner, the same colourful mug on its shelf, vertical 9:16, no text or signage.
shots.action: Kash walks past the mug shelf.
shots.mood: Contented smile, relaxed hands, Coin's proud cheerful expression.

shots.narration: Today, wait one day before buying anything you didn't plan.
shots.scene: Bright cafe tabletop with a floating sun–moon–sun picture sequence, vertical 9:16, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Coin holds up one finger beside the picture sequence.
shots.mood: Encouraging smile, clear simple composition, sunny friendly colours.

shots.narration: [excited] Next episode: can Kash pause for a tempting treat?
shots.scene: Cafe counter with one pastry beneath a clear glass dome, vertical 9:16, no labels or signage.
shots.action: Kash stops her reaching hand short of the pastry dome.
shots.mood: Playfully tempted expression, Coin's knowing grin, warm golden light.

episode.endHook: Next episode: can Kash pause when a tempting treat appears?
episode.description: An unplanned mug catches Kash's eye, but Coin introduces the 24-hour rule: wait one day before buying anything you didn't plan. A tiny everyday story about pausing an impulse purchase. General money education only.
